text:
sophia: Candidate build ready: candidate/2026.03.22-rc1 produced by CI. Need governance signoff and a canary toggle schedule. tagging @anika @kevin @oncall-sre @deploybot :megaphone:

deploybot: Artifact pushed: gcr.io/redwood/rc-2026-03-22:rc1 (sha: abc123def). CI smoke: passed. Digest: sha256:deadbeef

kevin: Quick checklist — release notes drafted? Any DB migrations? Feature flags ready? Need a short rollback plan in the thread.

anika: Release notes live in PR #456 (link: https://git/repo/pulls/456). No DB migrations in this candidate. Flags: `rc_canary` feature flag exists, default OFF. I'll flip it via ff-admin during canary.

matt: Canary proposal: start 5% traffic to region us-west for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then 100% if metrics OK. Gate thresholds: p95 latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% (5m window), cpu < 70% on inference nodes. Telemetry dashboards: /dashboards/rc-canary and /alerts/rc-canary.

oncall-sre: I'll be monitoring. My rule: if error rate >= 0.5% for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR p95 > 300ms for any 2 windows -> initiate rollback. Put me on pager. Also ensure KV cache warmup before traffic shift.

sophia: Plan for governance signoff: PM (kevin) and QE (anika) ack here; SRE oncall acked. If we get all thumbs, I will run the promote command. Proposed deploy command (ops):
```
/deploy promote --artifact rc-2026-03-22:rc1 \
  --canary 5% --region us-west \
  --flag rc_canary=true \
  --notes "2026.03.22 RC1: performance tweaks, bugfixes"
```

kevin: :thumbsup: PM signoff. Release notes approved.

anika: :white_check_mark: QA smoke passed in staging + a quick regression sweep on the prompt routing paths. Docs updated.

deploybot: Promote queued (id: promote-7390012345-01). ETA ~2m. To abort use `/deploy abort promote-7390012345-01`.

deploybot: Promotion started. Logs:
```
[00:00:05] pulling artifact gcr.io/redwood/rc-2026-03-22:rc1
[00:00:18] creating canary service in us-west
[00:01:04] canary ingress configured (5%)
```

oncall-sre: Observability runbook: https://wiki/redwood/rc-canary-runbook. Rollback playbook: runbook -> section "rollback" includes command below.

kevin: Adding release note link to product changelog after promote.

sophia: Canary 5% in us-west live. Monitoring for 30m.

oncall-sre: Seeing one-off 429 spikes at 00:07 — watching. If it persists for next 10m I'll escalate.

anika: Logs look clean on routing layer, 429s look like transient rate-limiter bump.

oncall-sre: 15m in, metrics stable, error rate 0.12%, p95 180ms.

sophia: Proceeding to 25% per plan. Running: `/deploy promote --id promote-7390012345-01 --step 2 --canary 25%`

deploybot: Canary ramp to 25% started.

oncall-sre: Monitoring window OK. No rollback.

sophia: After 1h at 25% and no breaches we will promote to 100% and flip `rc_canary` default -> ON for targeted routing. Final promote command: `/deploy promote --complete promote-7390012345-01 --to 100%`

deploybot: Promotion complete. All regions: 100% traffic now on rc-2026-03-22:rc1. Post-deploy checks: smoke OK, traces normal.

sophia: Done. Release notes published: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-22-rc1. If anyone sees regressions, follow rollback playbook:
```
/deploy rollback --to stable --reason "canary fail" --incident-id <INC>
```

kevin: Great, thanks team. I'll notify PM channel and update the productboard entry.

oncall-sre: Leaving a watch on this for another hour, then I'll hand back to standard rotation.

sophia: Closing thread — candidate promoted to prod. Will open post-release checkin thread in 1h. :tada:
